Чем больше передаточное число редуктора,: The larger the gear ratio, the stronger the joint. So why do humanoids built for learning still put actuators with a low gear ratio in their legs?
С ростом передаточного числа инерция рот: As the gear ratio grows, the rotor inertia at the output grows as its square: the actuator hits harder when the foot touches the floor, yields less to a push, and the force at the foot can no longer be estimated from the motor current
Большие редукторы не работают с нейросет: Large gearboxes don't work with neural network policies
Так устроены Mini Cheetah, Berkeley Huma: This is how Mini Cheetah, Berkeley Humanoid and the legs of Unitree robots are built. Through a 100 : 1 gearbox, friction and inertia eat up the link between the output force and the current, and manufacturers have to put torque sensors at the output.
У кисти Shadow 24 сустава и 20 моторов,: The Shadow hand has 24 joints and 20 motors, the Inspire 12 joints and 6 actuators. Does that mean the joints without a motor can't move?
Нет: один привод через тяги или тросы ве: No: one actuator drives several joints at once through linkages or tendons, but then their angles are coupled and can't be set independently
Нет: ими управляет пружина, а не привод: No: a spring controls them, not an actuator
Это недоприводные суставы: у Shadow четы: These are underactuated joints: in the Shadow hand four finger motions are coupled, and in the Inspire six actuators move twelve joints through linkages. A policy controls only as many quantities as there are actuators.
Тросы выносят моторы из пальцев в предпл: Tendons move the motors out of the fingers into the forearm. Why doesn't that make a humanoid's arm lighter?
Моторы никуда не исчезают: они переезжаю: The motors don't disappear: they move into the base of the hand, which still hangs at the end of the arm, and the shoulder actuator has to hold all the mass at the wrist end
Тросовые кисти всегда дороже, и экономят: Tendon-driven hands always cost more, so builders save on the arm actuators
Кисть Shadow весит 4,3 кг вместе с основ: The Shadow hand weighs 4.3 kg including the base, where its 20 motors sit. In the lab, such hands required 8518 actuators in the arms and 10413 in the legs. What becomes light are the fingers: in RUKA this gave more strength with the same motors as in LEAP.
Digit 360 is called a tactile sensor. What does it have besides a camera behind a gel, as in GelSight?
Датчики давления, вибрации, тепла и газа: Sensors for pressure, vibration, heat and gas, plus a neural network accelerator inside the finger itself that processes touch on the spot
Авторы сравнивают ускоритель в пальце с: The authors compare the accelerator in the finger to a reflex arc: the reaction to a touch event doesn't wait for the data to reach the main computer. The camera gives 240 frames a second, while texture vibrations can be heard up to 10 kHz.
Самый мощный вычислитель на борту даёт м: The most powerful onboard computer gives the model more room. So why isn't it put in every humanoid?
Он не помещается в корпус: It doesn't fit in the torso
Он тратит столько же энергии, сколько хо: It uses as much energy as walking: in the lab, Thor noticeably cut Ada's run time in every configuration
Большим моделям на борту нечего делать: Large models have nothing to do on board
Thor потребляет до 130 Вт, Orin NX до 40: Thor draws up to 130 W and Orin NX up to 40 W, while Ada's walking in the lab takes 55 to 132 W on average, depending on her mass. Thor instead of Orin NX cut the run time by at least 30% in every configuration. That's why companies split the model between the robot and the cloud or choose a computer to match the robot's size.
Вдвое большая батарея даст роботу вдвое: Will a battery twice as big give a robot twice the run time?
Да, время растёт вместе с энергией: Yes, the time grows along with the energy
Нет, больше чем вдвое: большие батареи э: No, more than twice: big batteries are more efficient
Нет, меньше чем вдвое: батарея тяжелее,: No, less than twice: the battery is heavier, carrying it costs more, and on a step the knees have to hold its mass
В лаборатории батарея как у H1 вместо ба: In the lab, a battery like the H1's instead of one like the G1's gave almost twice as much time in every configuration. A 2.3 kWh battery like Figure 03's would weigh almost 18 kg, and no actuator in the set would be enough for Ada's knee.
В таблице привода написано: пик 62,6 Н·м: An actuator's spec table says: peak 62.6 N·m, sustained 26.1 N·m. Which of these matters for an hour of walking with a load?
Пик: ходьба состоит из коротких усилий: The peak: walking consists of short efforts
Длительный момент: он задан нагревом мот: The sustained torque: it's set by the motor's heating, and motors that work near the peak for a long time overheat, like the Unitree robot's motors in TWIST after a few minutes of continuous operation, especially during squats
У приводов Berkeley Humanoid длительный: For the Berkeley Humanoid actuators, the sustained torque is 42–47% of the peak, for Nadia's actuators from a quarter to a third. The peak is needed for the step, the sustained torque for an hour of walking.
Облако снимает проблему бортовых вычисле: The cloud solves the onboard computing problem: a model of any size, and the robot just executes. What's wrong with this?
В облаке нельзя запускать модели зрения: Vision models can't run in the cloud
Ответ приходит с задержкой около четверт: The answer arrives about a quarter of a second late, and a walking robot covers centimeters in that time, while the whole-body controller and the joint controllers have to stay on board and run tens and thousands of times a second
Облачные модели не умеют работать с неск: Cloud models can't work with several robots
This is how Gemini Robotics from lesson 3.7 works, with its decoder on the robot, and so do the systems of lesson 6.4, with the whole-body controller at the lower level. The cloud suits infrequent decisions, not balance.
